note: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Three inputs: design-system/guidelines/figma/token-mapping.md (curated semantics, authoritative), scripts/figma-variables-snapshot.json (bulk, derived mechanically) and design-system/src/tokens/color/figma-spec.json (the generated --ds- color variables, read by their code syntax; the "color / foundations" paths come from this spec until the Figma push lands and the snapshot holds them). Every token in all three is validated against design-system/src/tokens/*.scss and design-system/src/tokens/color/*.scss. Run `npm run generate:token-registry`.
syncCommand: npm run sync:tokens && npm run generate:tokens
notes: Spacing is contextual: pick the layer-appropriate token family; there is no single Spacing/N token.
unknownTokens MUST be empty. A non-empty list means the .md references a token absent from SCSS.
figmaVariableCoverage.unresolved is the human to-do list: either the Figma variable has no code counterpart (a real gap) or deriveCandidates() needs widening. It never blocks the build.
